create_single_run_event: create a single run event with thread_id, run_id, event_type, and category using DbRunEventStore.put
batch_insert_run_events: batch insert multiple run events into the database using DbRunEventStore.put_batch for high-throughput writes
list_messages_for_thread: list message events for a thread with optional cursor-based pagination using DbRunEventStore.list_messages
list_events_for_run: list all events for a specific run filtered by event_types using DbRunEventStore.list_events
delete_events_by_thread: delete all run events for a thread and optionally scoped to a user using DbRunEventStore.delete_by_thread
